name: SettleCrime
description: Settle the player's non-violent bounty in your hold: pay it, take a bribe, or let it go when persuaded.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - World. Guards only. Pay and bribe ask you Yes/No first. Bribe and persuade need Advanced Actions on in Mantella. Keep Mantella's own AbsolveCrime off.

method.description: pay: the player pays the bounty; bribe: the player pays you extra to forget it; persuade: you let a minor bounty go.

prompt: If you are a guard, steward or Jarl and agree to settle the player's bounty (paid, bribed or persuaded), begin your response with '{key}:'
